description: We would love to say BRUU started out of love and affinity for tea, but that was not the case. Our founder was frustrated when the in-laws kept offering hot drinks to the family and instead of feeling left out, started to accept the occasional cup of tea. A new taste was forming but the tea bags being offered just wasn't cutting it.

SECTION 1 - Using the website
To register with www.bruutea.co.uk and purchase goods from our website you must be over eighteen years of age. You must ensure that the details provided by you on registration or at any time are correct and complete. You must inform us immediately of any changes to the information that you provided when registering by updating your personal details. We cannot take responsibility for E-Vouchers that cannot be delivered to the recipients email address because of spam filters, firewalls, capacity of the recipients mailbox or any other factors outside our control.

To redeem an E-Voucher simply enter the E-Voucher code featured in the email into the box provided at the end of the checkout process; where prompted during the Payment stage. In order to redeem your E-Voucher you must register with a valid email address on the website www.bruutea.co.uk. Only when you have completed your order will the E-Voucher be used. Only one E-Voucher may be used per order. An E-Voucher can only be redeemed against orders placed in GBP Sterling at www.bruutea.co.uk.

E-Vouchers cannot be used in conjunction with any 3rd party benefit. This includes cashback and loyalty partners. E-Vouchers cannot be used towards a promotion spend over. If you are not at home between 9:00am and 5:00pm Monday to Friday, we recommend arranging delivery to your work address. If we do deliver to you at home and no one is in, our couriers will leave a card telling you about how to collect your delivery. Any unclaimed or undelivered orders will eventually make their way back to our warehouse.

BRUU does not recommend customers to leave instructions to our couriers for your goods to be left outside your delivery address. Should the customer wish to proceed with this option, BRUU will not be responsible for any loss or damage.

If you are joining our Tea Club, then delivery in the UK is free and £4.99 for members living outside of the UK. Ordering other products on our website is free to UK customers when they spend over £10 and the rates vary for different countries. Please see the checkout for a more precise quote.
